C1178.title: SoundCloud Data Exposure Incident: Nearly 30 Million Accounts Impacted by API Enumeration Abuse
C1178.summary: SoundCloud suffered a data exposure incident impacting nearly 30 million accounts. Attackers exploited API enumeration abuse to exfiltrate data rather than directly breaching the database. This incident highlights the risk of large-scale data theft through API interface attacks.
